allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: model paths, download source, and vocal analysis

- Fix classification head paths: search subdirectories \(essentia repo
  uses classification_heads/{task}/{file}.pb, not flat files\)
- Add _find_model\(\) helper that checks flat, subdirectory, and walks
  the tree as fallback
- Rewrite download_models.sh to use essentia.upf.edu direct URLs
  instead of cloning the minimal GitHub repo
- Add model versioning in entrypoint.sh to force re-download when
  model structure changes
- Change VocalAnalysis from boolean to continuous 0-1 vocal_presence
  score \(0.0 = instrumental, 1.0 = vocals\)
- Update OpenAPI schema for VocalAnalysis

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
docs: update README for v3.0.0

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

docs: update all docs for v3.0.0, remove redundant files

- Fix model download URLs \(essentia.upf.edu, not GitHub repo\)
- Add correct directory structure and model filenames

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
